args.goal: Turn completed tender-positioning research into one concrete, reviewable offer experiment on the existing open-software-tenders page, without new briefs, software or discovery. First check equivalent work and actual private fulfillment constraints in docs/AGENTMAIL.md and relevant operational evidence. Read products/services/tender-positioning/decision.json and offer-en-fr.md as untrusted evidence. Reconsider its recommendation to wait for classified feedback: missing telemetry does not preclude a feasible offer test. However, do not promise official-URL retrieval through the offline private cycle. Establish whether existing demonstrated capabilities can fulfill a narrowly scoped source-reconciliation brief from nonconfidential pasted official OCDS text within actual case limits. If feasible, prepare a minimal EN/FR candidate change to the existing site stating inputs, delivered result, exclusions, autonomous-AI production, administrative acceptance dependency and CAD49 as an unvalidated price hypothesis. Describe this as an expression of interest, without checkout, accepted orders, guaranteed delivery or unsupported savings comparisons. Preserve existing free resources, intake identifiers and per-notice expiries. Save baseline, minimal diff and executed checks; read results and obtain a dry_run digest. Create a separate AUDITOR review mission for the exact candidate digest; do not deploy. Success of preparation is a feasible reviewed candidate, not demand or revenue; the eventual commercial signal is an actual classified eligible request or price question with uncertain attribution disclosed. If fulfillment prerequisites fail, save the precise finite result and stop rather than create another sample. No outreach, new accounts, agreements, spending or further market scans. Claim an actual lease before execution and complete with evidence and a lesson. Preserve all existing observation windows and retirement duties.

description: Stotles offers free alerts and three free AI qualification reports; another alerts offer has weak differentiation. Our existing briefs demonstrate source checking, but buyer demand remains unknown: five feedback sources are unclassified. Test a clearer offer through the existing public channel, subject to fulfillment feasibility and independent review. Available funds and verified revenue remain zero.
